# Ghoulvolution - Glow Meter Explained

Pour mes abonnés français: merci pour votre amour et votre soutien, ça compte énormément pour moi. 💖

*****Subject to change pending porting to live servers*****

**Other Ghoul Guides**

Your Glow Meter functions as a second health bar and a fuel tank. When you take damage or certain perk cards active, the green and grey striped bar decreases, and only radiation can refill it.

Stimpaks will not restore your health until your Glow Meter is completely gone, leaving you with only your primary health bar.

Unlike the Feral Meter, the Glow Meter has no fixed value. This is because it overlays your health bar, which can vary in value depending on your Endurance and any Perk Cards that increase your maximum HP.

You do not need a full Glow Meter to function as a Ghoul, and there are no penalties for having an empty Glow bar. However, many Ghoul Perk Cards will not activate without Glow, and most rely on it to power their abilities and buffs, making a full Glow Meter beneficial.

__How Glow is Lost__

Any item or effect that normally removes radiation—such as chems, environmental effects, or CAMP items like the Rad Shower—will instead remove Glow.

Glow can also be reduced by taking damage or when used as fuel by certain perk cards.

__How Radiation Resistance Affects the Glow Meter__

Radiation resistance controls how much radiation you absorb, which directly impacts how fast your Glow Meter refills. Your armor, underarmor, mods, legendary effects, and perk cards all influence your Rad Resistance.

- **High Rad Resistance** → Absorb less radiation, Glow Meter refills slower.
- **Low Rad Resistance** → Absorb more radiation, Glow Meter refills faster

__What Increases Rad Resistance?__

**Armour**

- Power Armor reduces radiation by 90%.
- Armour is the biggest source of Rad Resistance.
- __List of Body Armour sorted by Rad Resistance__

If you want to go Hard Core Ghoul, look for Body Armour with 0 Rad Resistance. Keep in mind that damage and energy resistance hit diminishing returns after 350, so non-meta or less popular armour might now be a viable option.

If you don’t want to swap armor or don’t like the look of low-Rad Resistance sets, you can use Perk Cards to reduce Rad Resistance or increase Rad intake:

- **Breathe It In** – Lowers Rad Resistance by 50, 100, or 150 depending on rank.
- **Glowing Gut** – Increases radiation from irradiated food and drinks by 100%, 200%, or 300%.
- **Rad Specialist** – Increases Rad intake by up to 50% when wearing a full matching armor or Power Armor set.

**Underarmour**

- Provides 5 to 15 Rad Resistance based on type.
- Downloadable graphic can be found __here__.

The best for Ghouls is Shielded Raider Underarmor since it gives 0 Rad Resistance and buffs Perception, Agility, and Luck (helping accuracy, AP regen, and VATS crit meter).

**Mods & Legendary Effects**

- Some armor mods add Rad Resistance.

**Perk Cards & Legendary Perk Cards**

- Some perk cards add Rad Resistance.

**Food Buffs**

- Nuka-Cola Orange
- Cola Perk Bubblegum

**Chems**

- Glowing Blood Pack – 75 Rad Resistance
- Irradiated Blood Pack – 75 Rad Resistance
- Rad-X – 200 Rad Resistance
- RadShield – 300 Rad Resistance

**Alcohol Buffs**

- Lead Champagne – 100 Rad Resistance
- Vintage Lead Champagne – 100 Rad Resistance
- Lead Champagne Mimosa – 100 Rad Resistance

**Other Sources**

- Lunchbox Bonus (Antacids) – +10% Radiation Resistance
- Scout’s Life 1 – Reduces Rad ingestion by 30%
- Tesla Science 6 – +15 Rad Resistance
- Karma Syringe – +25 Rad Resistance
- CAMP Ally: Maul – +20 Radiation Resistance

__How to Refill Your Glow Meter__

**Food and Drink**

The easiest way to refill your Glow Meter is to equip Glowing Gut and consume one of the three highest-rad foods below.

If you don’t have room under Endurance for multiple perk cards, prioritize Glowing Gut over Chem Diet. Your Feral Meter takes 2 hours to empty and there is no shortage of chems out in the wasteland.

A full list of food and drink and their rads can be found __here__.

| **Item** | **Radiation Base** | **Glowing Gut Rank 1** | **Glowing Gut Rank 2** | **Glowing Gut Rank 3** |
| Acidic Gulper Venom | 50 | 100 | 150 | 200 |
| Nuclear Wastewater | 50 | 100 | 150 | 200 |
| Toxic Goo | 50 | 100 | 150 | 200 |

**CAMP Items**

- Foundry Smelter – 125 rads
- __Blood Transfusion Pump__ – 140 rads
- Radioactive Barrel – 30 rads
- Asteroid – 30 rads
- Toxic Waste Pile – 30 rads
- Undetonated Bomb – 30 rads

**Environmental Sources**

- Grafton Dam
- Fissure Sites (run along the edge and stress everyone out)
- Nuke Zones
- Strangler Heart Acid Cloud
- Radiation Rumble tunnels (Emmett Mountain Disposal Site)
- Eviction Notice generator
- The Pitt
- Rivers and lakes

**Other Sources**

- Gamma Gun – 50 to 125 rads
- Radium Rifle – 30 rads
- Nuka Grenade – 125 rads

__Mutations__

- If you have the Herbivore mutation, plant-based dishes, and Teas won’t give you rads
- If you have the Carnivore mutation, meat-based dishes won’t give you rads
- Turning into a Ghoul will not affect your other mutations

__Glow-Related Perk Cards__

__Feral Rage__

**SPECIAL:**

Legendary Perk Card

**Perk Card Description**

When Feral, all Glow perk abilities cost less Glow.

- Rank 1: When Feral, all perk cards that use Glow will consume 20% less Glow.
- Rank 2: When Feral, all perk cards that use Glow will consume 30% less Glow.
- Rank 3: When Feral, all perk cards that use Glow will consume 40% less Glow.
- Rank 4: When Feral, all perk cards that use Glow will consume 50% less Glow.

**Note:**

Your Feral Meter must be empty/at 0% for this perk card to activate.

Below are the penalties for being in a Feral state, so keep that in mind when deciding if this perk card is right for you and your build:

**Feral Meter: 0% (Starving/Empty)**

- +150% Melee Damage
- -5 Endurance
- -30 Max HP
- -99 Charisma
- -20 Max AP
- -300% Hip-fire Gun Accuracy & V.A.T.S. Accuracy & Range

**Card Rank and Cost:**

1/2/3/4 - 50/100/150 Perk Coins

**Level unlocks**

Level 50

**Calculator**

Not Required

__Bomb Scientist__

**SPECIAL:**

Intelligence

**Perk Card Description**

Using Glow enhances the damage of your thrown grenades.

**Base Effect:**

- Rank 1 – Using 50 Glow, your thrown grenades deal +20% more damage.
- Rank 2 – Using 50 Glow, your thrown grenades deal +35% more damage.
- Rank 3 – Using 50 Glow, your thrown grenades deal +50% more damage.

#### **With Feral Rage Equipped**

Feral Rage reduces the Glow consumption based on rank but only activates when the Feral Meter is at Starving/Empty.

- Feral Rage Rank 1 – Thrown grenades consume 40 Glow.
- Feral Rage Rank 2 – Thrown grenades consume 35 Glow.
- Feral Rage Rank 3 – Thrown grenades consume 30 Glow.
- Feral Rage Rank 4 – Thrown grenades consume 25 Glow.

1/2/3

**Level unlocks**

Level 80

Not Required

__Mad Scientist__

**SPECIAL:**

Intelligence

**Perk Card Description**

Energy weapons consume a small amount of Glow per attack to deal increased damage.

#### **Base Effect**

- Rank 1 – Energy weapons consume 5 Glow per attack for +10% damage.
- Rank 2 – Energy weapons consume 5 Glow per attack for +15% damage.
- Rank 3 – Energy weapons consume 5 Glow per attack for +20% damage.

#### **With Feral Rage Equipped**

Feral Rage reduces the Glow consumption based on rank but only activates when the Feral Meter is at Starving/Empty.

- Feral Rage Rank 1 – Energy weapons consume 4 Glow per attack.
- Feral Rage Rank 2 – Energy weapons consume 3.5 Glow per attack.
- Feral Rage Rank 3 – Energy weapons consume 3 Glow per attack.
- Feral Rage Rank 4 – Energy weapons consume 2.5 Glow per attack.

#### **Conditions:**

- The player must be a Ghoul.
- The player must have at least 5 points of Glow.
- The player must be using an energy weapon.
- Gun-bashing does not trigger this effect.

1/2/3

__Rad Specialist__

**SPECIAL:**

Intelligence

**Perk Card Description**

Increases environmental radiation intake when wearing armor or power armor, with the effect doubling if wearing a matching set.

- Rank 1 – Increases radiation intake by 15% on armor and power armor, doubled if wearing a matching set (30%).
- Rank 2 – Increases radiation intake by 20% on armor and power armor, doubled if wearing a matching set (40%).
- Rank 3 – Increases radiation intake by 25% on armor and power armor, doubled if wearing a matching set (50%).

**Matching Set:**

Body Armour - Left Arm, Right Arm, Torso, Left Leg, Right Leg (Scout Armour also needs to be matching, it **can not** be a mix of Forest, Urban, Solar, etc)

Power Armour - Helmet, Left Arm, Right Arm, Torso, Left Leg, Right Leg
